name: refund_authorization
description: Rules governing who must approve refunds based on amount thresholds (e.g., <$100 agent, <$500 manager, >$500 director).

name: refund_restrictions
description: Specific conditions where refunds are prohibited or limited, such as gift card purchases requiring store credit only.

name: discount_limits
description: Caps on the percentage or value of discounts an agent can apply to any order (e.g., max 20%).

name: order_modification
description: Procedures for changing order details, including cancellations, returns, and shipping address updates.

name: customer_data_privacy
description: Protocols for accessing, viewing, or exporting sensitive customer information and records.
